Subtract 37 weeks and 2 days = 37*7 + 2 = 261 days.  
1628 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100).  
From 1628-01-04 subtract 261 days:  
Go back 4 days to 1627-12-31, then 257 more days.  
257 days before 1627-12-31:  
December has 31 days → back 30 days to 1627-12-01, then 227 days left.  
Go month by month backward:  
Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31, Jun 30, May 31, Apr 30, Mar 31, Feb 28 (1627 not leap), Jan 31.  
Count subtracted months until 227 days exhausted.  
Back from Dec 1:  
Nov (30) → 197 left, Oct (31) → 166 left, Sep (30) → 136 left, Aug (31) → 105 left, Jul (31) → 74 left, Jun (30) → 44 left, May (31) → 13 left.  
After subtracting May (31 days back from Jun 1), we reach April.  
44 days before Jun 1 is April 18 (Apr has 30 days: 44-30=14 → April 18).  
So 1627-12-01 minus 227 days = 1627-04-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1627-04-18
